snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate (Classic) - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Check it out on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4280890/Warhammer_40000_Chaos_Gate_Classic/

Originally released in 1998, Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate is a squad-based strategy game where you lead Ultramarines squads into battle against the forces of Chaos. The game is fondly remembered for its tactical depth and challenging yet fair gameplay.
